========================================

 • Visualization And Bi: Power BI, Tableau, Interactive Dashboard Creation, KPI Tracking & Reporting

========================================

  - Action & Result: Extracted spatial pose coordinates using MediaPipe/OpenCV, validated movement metrics against OpenCap gold-standard data, and developed a rule-based explainability module. Attained high correlation (R² > 0.89) against OpenCap 3D kinematics, enabling automated non-invasive screening.
• Customer Churn Prediction Model (Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Power BI)
  - Action & Result: Preprocessed customer behavioral logs, performed exploratory data analysis (EDA), built logistic regression and random forest classifiers, and constructed a Power BI tracking dashboard. Identified top 3 churn predictors and provided actionable retention strategies to reduce churn by 12%.

========================================

========================================

========================================
 • Programming Languages: Python, SQL

 • Visualization And Bi: Power BI, Tableau, Interactive Dashboard Creation, KPI Tracking & Reporting

========================================
• Maternal Health Risk Prediction (Published Research) (Python, SQL, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, SMOTE, Tableau)

• Customer Churn Prediction Model (Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Power BI)
  - Action & Result: Preprocessed customer behavioral logs, performed exploratory data analysis (EDA), built logistic regression and random forest classifiers, and constructed a Power BI tracking dashboard. Identified top 3 churn predictors and provided actionable retention strategies to reduce churn by 12%.

========================================

========================================
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
========================================
Results-oriented Data Analyst and MSc Artificial Intelligence & Data Science candidate with published research in clinical risk classification. Proficient in Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and statistical analysis with proven expertise in exploratory data analysis (EDA), data cleaning, predictive modeling (XGBoost, LightGBM, Scikit-Learn), and interactive dashboard design. Demonstrated track record of optimizing data pipelines, delivering actionable business metrics, and communicating data insights to cross-functional stakeholders in the UK.


========================================
CORE SKILLS & TECHNOLOGIES
========================================
 • Programming Languages: Python, SQL
 • Databases And Sql: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Relational Database Design, Complex Query Optimization
 • Data Science And Ml: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Statistical Analysis, Hypothesis Testing, Supervised Learning, Classification & Regression, SMOTE & Class Imbalance Handling, XGBoost, LightGBM, Scikit-Learn
 • Visualization And Bi: Power BI, Tableau, Interactive Dashboard Creation, KPI Tracking & Reporting
 • Libraries And Frameworks: Pandas, NumPy, OpenCV, MediaPipe, FastAPI, Streamlit
 • Devops And Tools: Git, GitHub Actions, Jupyter Notebooks, Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables)

========================================
KEY PROJECTS & MEASURABLE ACHIEVEMENTS
========================================
• Maternal Health Risk Prediction (Published Research) (Python, SQL, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, SMOTE, Tableau)
  - Action & Result: Engineered robust feature transformation scripts in Python, applied StratifiedKFold cross-validation with SMOTE sampling, and trained a Voting Ensemble (XGBoost + LightGBM + Random Forest). Achieved a 0.889 macro recall score and 0.857–0.858 cross-validated recall. Built an interactive Tableau dashboard to communicate diagnostic risk factors to medical reviewers.
• SOLiGence Barometer Ensemble System (Python, LightGBM, XGBoost, FastAPI, Streamlit, GitHub Actions)
  - Action & Result: Combined BiLSTM, XGBoost, and TCN models using a LightGBM meta-learner with a FinBERT sentiment pipeline; containerized and deployed via FastAPI and Streamlit. Reduced forecast error rates by 18% and automated daily pipeline updates via GitHub Actions.
• Sensorless Markerless Athlete Injury-Risk Screening (Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, XAI)
  - Action & Result: Extracted spatial pose coordinates using MediaPipe/OpenCV, validated movement metrics against OpenCap gold-standard data, and developed a rule-based explainability module. Attained high correlation (R² > 0.89) against OpenCap 3D kinematics, enabling automated non-invasive screening.
• Customer Churn Prediction Model (Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Power BI)
  - Action & Result: Preprocessed customer behavioral logs, performed exploratory data analysis (EDA), built logistic regression and random forest classifiers, and constructed a Power BI tracking dashboard. Identified top 3 churn predictors and provided actionable retention strategies to reduce churn by 12%.

========================================
EXPERIENCE
========================================
• Junior Data Analyst / Project Intern - Data Solutions Lab (2023 - 2024)
  - Queried structured relational databases using SQL to extract actionable business metrics, customer cohorts, and KPI trends.
  - Engineered automated Python data cleaning, transformation, and validation pipelines, reducing manual data preprocessing time by 40%.
  - Designed and published interactive Power BI and Tableau dashboards to track operational metrics for executive leadership.
  - Conducted rigorous exploratory data analysis (EDA) and statistical hypothesis testing to evaluate marketing campaign performance.

========================================

========================================
• MSc Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Solent University (2026)
  Published research in clinical risk classification. Coursework includes Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Statistical Analysis, Data Engineering, and Exploratory Data Analysis.

========================================
CERTIFICATIONS
========================================
• Data Analytics & Python for Data Science - Professional Certification (2024)
• SQL & Relational Database Design - Professional Certification (2024)

========================================
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
========================================

========================================
CORE SKILLS & TECHNOLOGIES
========================================
 • Programming Languages: Python, SQL
 • Databases And Sql: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Relational Database Design, Complex Query Optimization
 • Data Science And Ml: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Statistical Analysis, Hypothesis Testing, Supervised Learning, Classification & Regression, SMOTE & Class Imbalance Handling, XGBoost, LightGBM, Scikit-Learn
 • Visualization And Bi: Power BI, Tableau, Interactive Dashboard Creation, KPI Tracking & Reporting
 • Libraries And Frameworks: Pandas, NumPy, OpenCV, MediaPipe, FastAPI, Streamlit
 • Devops And Tools: Git, GitHub Actions, Jupyter Notebooks, Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables)

========================================
KEY PROJECTS & MEASURABLE ACHIEVEMENTS
========================================
• Maternal Health Risk Prediction (Published Research) (Python, SQL, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, SMOTE, Tableau)
  - Action & Result: Engineered robust feature transformation scripts in Python, applied StratifiedKFold cross-validation with SMOTE sampling, and trained a Voting Ensemble (XGBoost + LightGBM + Random Forest). • SOLiGence Barometer Ensemble System (Python, LightGBM, XGBoost, FastAPI, Streamlit, GitHub Actions)
  - Action & Result: Combined BiLSTM, XGBoost, and TCN models using a LightGBM meta-learner with a FinBERT sentiment pipeline; containerized and deployed via FastAPI and Streamlit. Reduced forecast error rates by 18% and automated daily pipeline updates via GitHub Actions.
• Sensorless Markerless Athlete Injury-Risk Screening (Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, XAI)
  - Action & Result: Extracted spatial pose coordinates using MediaPipe/OpenCV, validated movement metrics against OpenCap gold-standard data, and developed a rule-based explainability module. Attained high correlation (R² > 0.89) against OpenCap 3D kinematics, enabling automated non-invasive screening.
• Customer Churn Prediction Model (Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Power BI)
  - Action & Result: Preprocessed customer behavioral logs, performed exploratory data analysis (EDA), built logistic regression and random forest classifiers, and constructed a Power BI tracking dashboard. Identified top 3 churn predictors and provided actionable retention strategies to reduce churn by 12%.

========================================
EXPERIENCE
========================================

  - Queried structured relational databases using SQL to extract actionable business metrics, customer cohorts, and KPI trends.
  - Engineered automated Python data cleaning, transformation, and validation pipelines, reducing manual data preprocessing time by 40%.
  - Designed and published interactive Power BI and Tableau dashboards to track operational metrics for executive leadership.
  - Conducted rigorous exploratory data analysis (EDA) and statistical hypothesis testing to evaluate marketing campaign performance.

========================================

  Published research in clinical risk classification. Coursework includes Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Statistical Analysis, Data Engineering, and Exploratory Data Analysis.

CERTIFICATIONS
========================================

• SQL & Relational Database Design - Professional Certification (2024)
